title: Accelerating Distributed DLRM Training with Optimized TT Decomposition and Micro-Batching
problem: Deep Learning Recommendation Models suffer from high memory demands of embedding tables and significant communication overhead in distributed training. Existing compression techniques like Tensor-Train decomposition, while effective, introduce substantial computational burdens.
motivation: DLRMs are pivotal in various sectors, necessitating efficient training approaches to handle embedding table memory requirements and distributed communication overhead.
method: EcoRec compresses the large lookup tables (embedding layers) used in recommendation systems using Tensor-Train decomposition—a technique that splits a massive data structure into smaller, interconnected pieces. It optimizes this compression by removing redundant calculations that normally occur when these pieces interact, and uses micro-batching where data is sorted by index so related items train together, reducing memory without slowing things down. To handle training across multiple machines, it uses a pipeline system for the embedding layers that keeps the data balanced and flowing smoothly between GPUs, all built on PyTorch and CUDA.
key_novelty: Eliminating redundancy from Tensor-Train compression through optimized operations, while combining it with sorted micro-batching and distributed pipeline training.
contributions: Novel computation pattern for TT decomposition that eliminates redundancy in TT operations
Efficient multiplication pathway significantly reducing computational time
Micro-batching technique with sorted indices for memory reduction without additional computational costs
Novel pipeline training system for embedding layers with balanced data distribution and enhanced communication efficiency
limitations: Evaluation limited to 32 GPU cluster; scalability to larger systems and generalization beyond recommendation workloads not discussed.
primary_theme: Optimized distributed DLRM training via TT decomposition and pipelining
